name: Salome
overview: Salome is identified in the Gospels as a devoted follower of Jesus, present at both His crucifixion and the burial site, where she, along with other women, prepared spices to anoint His body. She is also recognized as the mother of Zebedee's sons, James and John, who sought Jesus' favor for their sons to sit at His right and left in His kingdom, demonstrating her role in interceding for her children. These accounts highlight her presence during critical moments of Jesus' passion and her familial connection to prominent disciples.
